scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tqa/shared build && pnpm --filter @tqa/api build && pnpm --filter @tqa/storefront build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tqa/shared build && pnpm --filter @tqa/api build && pnpm --filter @tqa/storefront typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/contract/*.test.ts
